preprocessing: gentle; remove IMC privacy placeholders before adaptation
training_weight: Equal total weight per class; within class equal weight per source; within each source/class equal total weight per campaign group. Rescale weights to mean 1. No class_weight.
selection: Fit six candidates on train only. Choose threshold and candidate by maximum macro-average spam recall over validation sources, subject to empirical FPR <= 0.01 separately on historical and financial ham. Ties: smaller macro FPR, higher threshold (within candidate); feature order word/char/word_char then smaller C (across candidates).
test_rule: Only selected candidate and frozen baseline; no further tuning after test inspection. Report financial and SMS history separately.
promotion_rule: Research candidate only unless paired group-bootstrap 95% lower bound for SMS-history F1 improvement is positive AND candidate FPR <= baseline FPR AND candidate FPR <= 0.01 separately on both new test sources. Passing does not establish representative production safety.

uncertainty.method: paired class-stratified campaign-group bootstrap, conditional on the fixed fitted models and sampled sources

source_audit: No model scores were consulted during source, cohort or split preparation.
